mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in two months signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 2 months and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 YoY < 2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.
